_comment: Cross-language test vectors for facex BiometricMatcher and FaceAffectMapper. All 10 language implementations must match within 1e-5 tolerance. Do NOT use bitwise equality — float rounding differs across SIMD/scalar paths.
_convention: Landmarks are 68 (x,y) pairs normalized to [0.0,1.0] relative to the face bounding box, stored as flat float[136]. Expression deltas are applied to AffectState initial values.

cosine_similarity_vectors.description: Two identical 2-element L2-normalised vectors. cos_sim must be 1.0.
Two orthogonal 2-element unit vectors. cos_sim must be 0.0.
Two opposing unit vectors. cos_sim must be -1.0.
4-element embeddings from the same person under different lighting. Must exceed default threshold 0.85.
4-element embeddings from two different people. Must fall below default threshold 0.85.
Similarity exactly equals threshold. IsMatch must return true (>=).

_dimension_mismatch_contract: Every entry in dimension_mismatch_vectors MUST be REFUSED, never scored. C# and Kotlin throw, TypeScript and HarmonyOS throw, Swift throws BiometricError.embeddingDimensionMismatch, Go returns ErrEmbeddingDimensionMismatch, Python raises ValueError, Rust panics. C is the sole exemption and cannot express the case: ca_biometric_cosine_similarity takes ONE length n for both vectors, so a mismatch is unrepresentable in its signature. This array exists because every row in cosine_similarity_vectors is EQUAL-LENGTH, so nothing forced the ports to agree on invalid input and they silently diverged three ways.

dimension_mismatch_vectors.description: A 1-element embedding against a 2-element one. Python truncated to the shorter vector via zip and returned 0.894 — past the 0.85 default threshold, i.e. a false match between embeddings that never came from the same model.
The same mismatch with the arguments reversed. A port that guards only one side passes the row above and fails this one.
Empty against non-empty. Distinct from two EMPTY vectors, which every port answers 0.0 for — only a genuine length mismatch is refused.

affect_mapper_vectors.description: Happy expression observed from a neutral AffectState.
Stressed expression increments Uncertainty and decrements Energy.
Angry expression decrements Engagement and Rapport.
Neutral expression must not mutate any axis.
Confidence below 0.5 must produce no change regardless of expression.
Happy signal from near-max engagement must clamp at 1.0.
